Native standard Contact rule first-name capture (C9 panels c9s1, c9s2)
Date: 2026-11-15 UTC.
Org: one fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org on an authorized campaign Dev Hub, deleted after the run; deletion verified (active hub record 1 -> 0, the local target no longer resolves). No record, org or user id, username, alias or host is stored.
APIs: 62.0 and 67.0. Routes: anonymous Apex and deployed @IsTest; two repeats. Eight observations per case; every case has eight identical observations.
Rule: Standard_Contact_Duplicate_Rule. A three-value canary (exact twin plus an unrelated value) ran with the cases at each API and route.
Probe: one record per value is inserted (DMLOptions allowSave), then Datacloud.FindDuplicates runs on an unsaved copy of every value; only matches of the named rule are reported. Observation: <value count>:<pairs>; a pair is <candidate index><existing index><confidence>, indexes in 0-9a-z, a missing confidence is 100.
Companion fields: every value carries one shared last name and email address ("first|last|email"), so only the first name differs.
Values: common first names and nicknames as test-data shapes; no person is described.
The same observations are also stored with the Title panels of the run (fuzzy_title_variant, group c9s).
